fixture_cases.context: A woman-shaped hole in the air stands before you. This woman-shade knows she does not belong here in your mind. You turn back to the woman-shaped void. She continues to face you, hands held out imploringly, ignoring the Specter completely.

fixture_cases.source: Qira pointed to her brother. "Shade, come here."
